question: Should this PR wait for exact-head `validate_docker_openwebui` proof before merge, or is the posted planner/workflow validation enough for this release-CI change?
rationale: The patch changes release workflow scheduling and runner placement, and the PR body says the authoritative live Docker proof is still pending.

options.title: Wait for exact-head OpenWebUI proof
options.body: Require a stable/full reusable workflow or release-matrix artifact showing the dedicated OpenWebUI job completes on `blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404` before merge.

options.title: Accept planner-only proof
options.body: Merge based on static planner/workflow tests and accept the risk that the live image pull path has not run from this head.

recommendation.title: Wait for exact-head OpenWebUI proof
recommendation.body: Require a stable/full reusable workflow or release-matrix artifact showing the dedicated OpenWebUI job completes on `blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404` before merge.
